remarks: Move-in ready three-bedroom ranch in the ‘burg! Set on a side street off Ivory, this home is in the heart of Frewsburg. The schools are within walking distance, along with the public library and various dining options. The home is heated with hot-water baseboard heat and also has a separate forced-air Central A/C system. Inside, the home has a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace, a built-in curio cabinet, and a large picture window bringing in warm, natural light. The eat-in kitchen has a breakfast bar and a pantry, with space to add a small dining table or a breakfast nook. The formal dining room features French doors onto the patio for seamless entertaining. The primary bedroom is large, with two closets and an en-suite bath. The full basement is partially finished, there is a spacious recreation room with a bar and a second wood-burning fireplace, such a great space for entertaining guests! The unfinished part of the basement offers more storage space and workshop space. Outside, the home has an attached two-car garage with water service. The home is set on a double lot, giving you plenty of space to plant a garden or host summertime barbecues. The current owner has just put on a new roof, and a brand-new septic system will be installed prior to closing.  List agent is related to seller.
